column1: # The Detection Posture fold (#3786 item 3).
# One row per lever in platform/decision/legacycompile/legacy_posture_levers.tsv,
# naming where that lever lands once the static/dynamic split is retired. A
# lever with no destination is a deployment setting that silently stops working
# at v11, so the census test refuses one.
# THIS FILE IS THE FOLD TABLE, NOT technical-docs/designs/DETECTOR_REGISTRY_DESIGN.md.
# The design doc renders the same rows as prose and cites this file. The table
# lives here because the doc does NOT reach the community mirror (verified with
# scripts/ci/simulate-community-mirror.sh) while this package and the census
# test both do - a test parsing the doc's markdown would go red on the mirror
# for a file that is correctly absent there, and would be parsing prose to
# assert a fact besides.
# census_rows is DERIVED, not declared: it is the number of rows in
# detectors_census.tsv whose posture_lever column equals this lever, and the
# test recomputes it. A lever whose population moves without this file moving
# is red.
lever
DANGEROUS_COMMAND_ACTION
column2: the called tool's declared posture (PROPOSED vocabulary - NOT registry.Posture, which is Unmatched/OnError failure semantics and cannot carry a block-on-match; the ADR-065 home is an action tag plus a constraint policy), plus emit on the security-dangerous detector documents
column4: Dangerous-command posture is a property of the TOOL being invoked, not of the content inspected. Ten of these rows evaluate on seven planes rather than nine (phase_not_evaluated_on_this_plane), so a content-side home would leave two planes unreachable.

column1: PII_ACTION
column2: ScoringPolicy (PROPOSED vocabulary - no such entity exists in ADR-065 or the tree today) threshold on the pii-* detector documents, plus each document's emit
column4: Two census rows already carry posture_lever_displaces_stored_action, i.e. the lever overrides the stored action today. The fold makes that explicit per document instead of implicit per deployment.

column1: SENSITIVE_DATA_ACTION
column2: ScoringPolicy (PROPOSED, see PII_ACTION) threshold on the sensitive-data detector documents
column4: Straight threshold fold; no tool posture involved.

column1: SQLI_ACTION
column2: emit on the security-sqli detector documents, and the called tool's declared posture (PROPOSED, see DANGEROUS_COMMAND_ACTION) for query-bearing tools
column4: The largest category. Migration 067 already performs the same operation once at migration time (UPDATE ... WHERE category IN ('security-sqli','sqli')); the fold removes one of the two places an SQLi action is decided.
